name: sxgerador
description: Plataforma open source para criar, versionar e gerar migrations AdvPL de dicionario de dados Protheus.
author: Gustavo Pals

scripts.lint: eslint . --ext .js,.cjs,.mjs,.ts,.html --ignore-pattern apps --ignore-pattern packages && turbo run lint
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f tools/docker/docker-compose.yml down && rm -rf tools/docker/data/postgres && docker compose -f tools/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json tsconfig.base.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md commitlint.config.cjs .eslintrc.cjs .prettierrc "apps/*/{package.json,README.md,angular.json,tsconfig*.json}" "apps/*/prisma/**/*.ts" "apps/*/prisma.config.ts" "apps/*/src/**/*.{ts,html,scss}" "packages/*/{package.json,README.md,tsconfig.json,tsup.config.ts,vitest.config.ts}" "packages/*/src/**/*.ts" tools/docker/docker-compose.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json tsconfig.base.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md commitlint.config.cjs .eslintrc.cjs .prettierrc "apps/*/{package.json,README.md,angular.json,tsconfig*.json}" "apps/*/prisma/**/*.ts" "apps/*/prisma.config.ts" "apps/*/src/**/*.{ts,html,scss}" "packages/*/{package.json,README.md,tsconfig.json,tsup.config.ts,vitest.config.ts}" "packages/*/src/**/*.ts" tools/docker/docker-compose.yml
